passage.label: Patience over what they say and remembrance of Dawud possessor of strength repeatedly turning back; mountains subjected to exalt with him at afternoon and sunrise; birds assembled repeating with him; kingdom strengthened with wisdom and discernment in speech; the adversaries climbing the prayer-chamber wall alarming him; two litigants asking judgement in truth without excess and guidance to the sound path; the ninety-nine ewes against one ewe and overpowering in speech; his verdict of wrongdoing, the oppression of associates except the believing doers of good who are few; his certainty of being tried, seeking forgiveness, falling bowing and turning; forgiveness with nearness and a good return; appointment as successor commanded to judge in truth and not follow desire which leads astray with severe punishment for forgetting the Day of Account; heaven and earth not created aimlessly, that being the disbelievers' assumption bringing woe from the Fire; refusal to treat believers like corrupters or the God-fearing like the wicked; a blessed Book revealed for reflection and reminder to those of understanding

arabicExcerpts.text: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
۞وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ

قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعٗاۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ

يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ

mainSubject.label: Patience commanded alongside remembrance of Dawud as possessor of strength and repeated return; mountains and birds joined in his glorification at fixed times; kingdom reinforced by wisdom and decisive speech; the chamber-wall intrusion of two litigants presenting the ewe dispute; his verdict naming associate oppression with the believing exception, followed by recognition of the trial, forgiveness-seeking, prostration and repentance; divine pardon granting nearness and good return; the khilafah charge to judge in truth and refuse desire, with severe punishment tied to forgetting the Day of Account; creation declared purposeful against the disbelievers' aimlessness assumption; categorical refusal to equate believers with corrupters; the blessed Book given for tadabbur and reminder

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant David, possessor of strength, who repeatedly turned back.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: O David, We made you a successor on earth, so judge between people in truth.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not follow desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah.

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 ends at the punishment-hastening demand (16) before the patience command opens the Dawud block (17); P2 closes with the blessed-Book reflection verse (29); P3 groups the Sulayman, Ayyub and patriarch remembrance sequence (30-48); P4 is the two-returns contrast ending with the Fire quarrel (49-64); P5 begins with the warner-only declaration and runs through the Adam-Iblees narrative to the closing reminder (65-88).
